messages:
incident-bot: Pager — Elevated 5xx rate detected for /v1/infer on apigw-edge starting ~2026-03-15T02:10Z. Error mix: 502 and 504. 5m rolling 5xx = 7.8% (threshold 2%). Pager sent to @tara (oncall) and @sre-rotation-bot.

tara (oncall): ack — I'm on. Creating incident channel and grabbing traces. Setting this thread as primary coordination.

alex f: looking at ingress dashboards now. Spike starts ~02:09 UTC. Traffic fanout seems normal but upstreams returning TIMEOUT/502. Primarily us-west-2 & eu-west-1 edge clusters.

priya: can someone check recent deploys/configs? will pull envoy and nginx logs for edge nodes.

mike (infra): checking deploy timeline — there was an envoy config push via configbot at 02:08:52 (id: cfg-20260315-0208). Also seeing a kube HPA event at 02:07 that didn't scale much.

tara (oncall): support-lead, can you triage customer impact and surface any high-sev customers?

support-lead: FYI: initial query to billing/usage shows ~23 tenants with elevated error rates. Top impacted: acme-corp (73% of requests failing), playstream (44%). CS is standing by.

alex f: pulled a sample trace — upstream runtime-frontend responds with 504 (upstream timeout). stack trace shows blocked queueing in `runtime-frontend` with CPU near 95% for certain pods.

priya: I'm going to reroute a small percentage of traffic to fallback pool (dedicated-fallback) to reduce pressure on runtime-frontend. Will start with 5%.

mike (infra): agree — also raising gateway upstream timeout from 25s -> 45s temporarily might reduce 504s while we scale backend. patching envoy timeout now.

priya: executed route change: `kubectl patch svc apigw-edge -p '{"spec":{"trafficShift": {"fallback": 0.05}}}'` — 5% diverted.

priya: scaling runtime-frontend deployment: `kubectl scale deployment runtime-frontend --replicas=6 -n inference` (was 3).

mike (infra): rollback candidate: configbot pushed `cfg-20260315-0208`. I'm preparing a rollback plan if we don't see improvement in 5m.

[some logs pasted by alex f]:
```
[02:10:12] ingress-node-22 envoy upstream reset: upstream reset before response complete - 504
[02:10:14] runtime-frontend-2 CPU=96% memory=72% queue_wait=421ms
[02:11:02] client-req: /v1/infer latency=32s -> upstream timeout
```

tara (oncall): declaring incident P1 due to customer impact. Incident Commander = tara (oncall). Runbook: 1) Mitigate customer impact (routing + scale) 2) If config rollback reduces failures, roll back; 3) Postmortem.

priya: scale complete. runtime-frontend pods at desired=6, available=6.

mike (infra): envoy timeout increased to 45s cluster-wide. also disabled keepalive pooling for a subset of upstreams to avoid head-of-line.

alex f: dashboards showing 5xx down from 7.8% -> 3.1%  (02:15 UTC). Latency still elevated for some clients. Diverted 5% helps but acme-corp still seeing spikes (they're in us-west-2).

support-lead: CS notified top affected customers. Preparing status message: "We are aware of elevated errors for inference API and are actively mitigating. Next update in 30m or when service restores."

mike (infra): configbot rollback queued (cfg-20260315-0208) -> manual approval required. Recommend wait 10m to see scaling + timeout effect before rollback.

priya: agree. waiting 10m window. I'll keep monitoring traces for 502/504 signatures.

[02:22] alex f: good signal: 5xx down to 1.4% across clusters, us-west-2 still ~4.8% but trending down.

tara (oncall): good. keeping incident open for follow-up. owners: runtime-frontend scaling & perf — priya; ingress config & rollback — mike; customer comms — support-lead; postmortem — tara.

sre-rotation-bot: Paging rotation note — oncall handoff to alex f in 55 minutes.

priya: note — found increased tail latency in model runner where a GC spike correlated with pod CPU pressure. We'll instrument GC settings and add mem/cpu requests so autoscaler triggers earlier.

mike (infra): created a temporary autoscaler override to lower CPU target for runtime-frontend to 50% to trigger faster scaling. Monitor for oscillation.

support-lead: Status update dispatched to customers at 02:28 UTC. No ETA yet.

tara (oncall): next steps: 1) keep fallback traffic at 5% until 5xx < 1% for 10m 2) if us-west-2 doesn't recover, escalate to infra to provision extra capacity in that region 3) postmortem with timeline + configbot action.

alex f: watching logs. if we see configbot config reapply, I'll flag and block further pushes until postmortem.

mike (infra): noted. standing by to rollback if metrics worsen.

[02:34] alex f: Last update: 5xx stabilized ~0.8% cluster-wide, us-west-2 at 1.6%. CPU across runtime-frontend pools back to ~60%.

tara (oncall): thanks team. Incident remains P1 open. I'll spin up a postmortem doc and assign follow-ups. If anything regresses ping here immediately. :thumbsup:
